data.title: Volunteer orientation
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Welcome aboard. I'm Beatrix Olowe, I coordinate the volunteers at St Aldric's Hospital. Speaker 2: Thanks, I'm looking forward to it. Speaker 1: You'll be on the oncology ward's reading cart on Saturdays, so the patient-confidentiality module has to be done before your first shift on the 24th. Speaker 2: I'll finish the confidentiality module before the 24th. Speaker 1: And bring your vaccination record to the orientation on Monday; occupational health checks everyone's. Speaker 2: I'll bring it on Monday. Speaker 1: Lovely. The cart has large-print books, if anyone asks.
